facts.statement: The Company enters into currency options and coupon only swaps to hedge cash flows associated with floating interest rate external currency borrowing.
facts.quote:
The Company enters into currency options 
and coupon only swaps to hedge cash flows 
associated with floating interest rate external 
currency borrowing.

facts.statement: The Company's financial assets comprise mainly of investments, cash and cash equivalents, other balances with banks, trade receivables and other receivables.
facts.quote:
The Company’s financial assets comprise mainly of investments, cash and cash equivalents, other balances with banks, trade 
receivables and other receivables and financial liabilities comprise mainly of borrowings, trade payables and other payables.

facts.statement: The Company is exposed to Market risk, Credit risk and Liquidity risk.
facts.quote: The Company is exposed to Market risk, Credit risk and Liquidity risk.

facts.statement: The Board of Directors oversees the management of financial risks through its Risk Management Committee.
facts.quote:
The Board of Directors (‘Board’) oversee the management 
of these financial risks through its Risk Management Committee.

facts.statement: The Company has taken Cross Currency Interest Rate Swap in order to hedge floating interest rate risk exposure related to its JPY denominated external commercial borrowing.
facts.quote:
The Company has taken Cross Currency Interest Rate Swap in order to hedge floating interest rate risk exposure 
related to its JPY denominated external commercial borrowing.

facts.statement: The Company enters into forward exchange contracts for crystalised foreign exchange and firm commitment exposure falling due in next 90 days.
facts.quote:
As per the policy, the Company enters into forward exchange contracts for crystalised foreign exchange 
and firm commitment exposure falling due in next 90 days and into a call spread option to hedge foreign exchange 
risk exposure related to JPY denominated external commercial borrowing.
